changes.change: Reuse one generated sync pipeline; custom policies work and normal close releases the session transport.
Drain cancelled heartbeat tasks before session close/delete and async client close; concurrent cancellation does not interrupt cleanup.
Default raw-operation pipelines receive existing environment-backed identity headers scoped to the configured origin and session path; caller overrides and custom pipelines are preserved.
Public credential annotations resolve and include the already-supported API-key credential; no authentication-policy tightening.
Explicit non-batch 413 fields retain generic handling; invalid/non-finite/negative 503 retry hints do not replace the typed service error.
Reject empty logical training batches before any POST or fabricated successful handle.
Require a sampler path or sampling-session ordinal instead of creating ssNone identifiers.
Creation polls reject malformed/unknown status and tolerate bounded request-store 404 without resubmitting creation.
Creation and sustained-error retry waits are clamped to remaining deadlines/budgets.
Forward chunking runs off-loop like forward/backward; synchronous chunk fan-out has a fixed 32-worker ceiling.
Deletion accepts only 2xx or idempotent 404; unhandled redirects fail without deleting async resource mappings.
Normal INFO create/completion logs contain identifiers rather than response payloads; explicit verbose body logging remains opt-in.
An empty raw continuation token raises ValueError before submission instead of an unbound-local implementation error.
Sync heartbeat requests use bounded I/O options; if join times out, lifecycle raises and retains the live thread reference instead of racing close/delete.
Image mappings pass through ImageChunk validation; invalid signatures and token counts cannot bypass the handwritten checks.
Completed-wave and multichunk async methods return an actual completed Task, not a plain Future, matching their public annotation.
Correct the lastResort message-only formatter documentation; no logging behavior change.
ModelInput field and constructor overload accept the already-supported ImageChunk alongside token chunks.

deferred_contract_decisions.reason: Changing heartbeat startup to opt-in changes the tested session-liveness default; retain until an explicit API/lifecycle decision.
Remote API-key HTTP rejection changes an existing compatibility/authentication policy and requires security review; recommend HTTPS now.
No verified server deduplication contract; changing non-idempotent submission recovery needs service-owner review and fault-injection validation. Do not claim existing retries are duplicate-safe.

Replacing or removing the legacy raw async LRO API changes the explicitly preserved preview contract, including continuation/custom-poll semantics. Keep its documented limitation and use tested request-ID conveniences until an API decision.
